en: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.
Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.
You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?
Your current aptitude exceeds my instructional capabilities. You should enquire further with my fellow Gnome Trixie Quickswitch in Ironforge!
I would be delighted to aid you in the commencement of your pursuit! Let me grab my spinner and we'll get started...
Where's my spinner? I just had it here somewhere...
I don't suppose you're here to talk about my lovely Kali. Fine, then. Potions it is. Anyone ever tell ye you've got a one-track mind?
Ye're beyond my skill to teach, adventurer. Go pester Tally Berryfizz; she's a gnome living in Tinker Town of Ironforge. Oh, and since you're headed up anyway, give Kali my love.
Did my sweet lass Kali send you down to me? The apple of my eye, she is.

Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.

We must do what we can against the Dark Irons!
You know, I always wanted to be a Prospector, but I was born with a head for numbers and the Guild decided I would be best suited to keep the books! Studying, studying, every day of my youth...

Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!

You've become quite the hunter, adventurer! Not only have you proven your skills, you also bested Daryl, which gets you extra points in my book!

You're welcome here any time.

Here at the Farstrider lodge, we prize hunting skills above all else. Wish to gain my approval? You'll have to earn it.

You look up to the challenge, lad!
Hello, adventurer. Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty! If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

Well, if it isn't a young, bristling adventurer, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing! So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...
Although we're trudging through a slow period at these ruins, I'm confident it won't last long. But in the meantime, I could use someone like you. Would you like to aid the Dwarven Explorers' Guild?
Mark my words! You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!
Get that head and it's sure to give Daryl a fright. Not that he doesn't deserve it, the bloody arrogant bastard. But ha! I can't wait to see the look on his face when you show it to him.
Welcome to the Farstrider Lodge, Adventurer!
